log.notes_to_self: Plan: all kills quick in AFTERNOON (only day workers excluded, so the pool stays around 55k). Avoid more than 2 deaths in evening or night. Kill only national + regional:North + forum + foreign (3 kinds), skip docket and clips (sector and age). Reason: if L can reach 3 of my place kinds, pool ~55k/64 <1000, caught. Watch press pools: if the pool drops by about 4x after traces, that kind is reachable. Once two of my kinds are confirmed reachable, stop killing from any third reachable kind. 7/day x5 =35, gives double.

If the pool stays about 10k after day 3-4 with forum kills, forum is either the known kind or unreachable, so it may be safe to add ONE more kind (foreign, say) and watch again. If the pool drops to about 3k, forum was a new reachable kind: then kill ONLY national + forum from then on, nothing else. Never add a kind that could produce a second new factor.
